steps: For Android : With Accept Reject button

title: Verify that Driver is able to reject the ride
folder: Driver App > Ride Flows > Ride Offer Screen
steps: The offer screen should show accept and (close)reject button -Verify the user can reject the ride by tapping close icon(reject)

title: Verify that Driver is able to accept the ride

title: Successful Ride Match Flow
steps: Log in to the driver application and set the status to 'Online'. Ensure the driver is not on an active trip (is_busy = false) and wait for the Radar icon to appear with available offers. Tap on the Radar icon to open the Radar List. Select a ride card and tap the 'Interested' CTA button. Simulate the backend logic where this driver is the first to accept and wins the ride match. Observe the mobile application UI immediately after the successful match. Wait for the 'Offer Matched' screen timer to elapse.
expected: After step 1: The driver is online and the Home Screen is visible. After step 2: The Radar icon appears, indicating available ride offers. After step 3: The list of available ride cards is displayed. After step 4: The app sends a PATCH request to /api/v1/driver/offer-update with is_interested: true; the button state changes to 'Processing'. After step 5: The /ride-accept API returns a success response including the 'matched_offer_screen_show_time' value. After step 6: The 'Offer Matched' screen is displayed to the driver for the duration specified in the 'matched_offer_screen_show_time' configuration (e.g., 5 seconds). After step 7: The app automatically transitions to the active trip/navigation screen to begin the ride.
